definitions.gloss: villain role, antagonist, bad guy (in a story)
definitions.explanation: The role of the villain or antagonist in a play, movie, story, or other narrative. Also refers to the actor or person playing such a role. By extension, someone who takes on an unpopular or thankless role in real life.

examples.japanese: {悪役|あくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪役|あくやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{似合|にあ}う→似合う：02134_niau⟧。
examples.english: That actor suits villain roles well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦しなければ→する：00392_suru⟧⟦なら→なる：01970_naru⟧ず、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{悪役|あくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けている→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
examples.english: I always have to be the bad guy because I need to scold my subordinates strictly.

notes:
USAGE:
{悪役|あくやく} primarily refers to the villain or antagonist role in dramas, movies, anime, and other narratives. It is also used figuratively for someone who takes on an unpopular role in real life, such as being the disciplinarian or delivering bad news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪役|あくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to play the villain
- {悪役|あくやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧: to take on the bad-guy role
- {悪役|あくやく}⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧: actor known for villain roles
- {悪役|あくやく}レスラー: heel wrestler

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪役|あくやく}: villain role (the role or character itself)
- ⟦{悪党|あくとう}→悪党：12674_akutou⟧: villain, scoundrel (an actual bad person)
- {敵役|かたきやく}: antagonist role (emphasizes being the opponent)
